name: @neo-health/mcp-server
description: Hosted MCP server for the Neo Health team-shared Claude knowledge base. Serves vault search/read, module summaries, related-PRD lookup, and FHIR-resource introspection over HTTP (for boss/Claude.ai via Custom Connector) and stdio (for devs via .mcp.json). Reads from a local clone of neohealth-org/claude-config that's git-pulled on a schedule.
